quarterly_data.signal: Air Liquide announced a new investment of more than 170 million euros to supply ultra-high purity gases to an unnamed leading semiconductor manufacturer in Japan under a long-term agreement, supporting the expansion of the customer's existing logic chip production facility in Japan's Southern semiconductor hub. Air Liquide will build, own and operate several production units delivering large volumes of ultra-pure nitrogen, oxygen, argon and hydrogen, including significant backup storage capacity. The company describes it as a renewed partnership and ties the demand to the AI and high-performance computing markets.
quarterly_data.figure: more than 170 million euros investment (customer not named)
